meta.name: Rey Tigre
meta.description: El encargado de un zoológico pierde la cabeza en esta historia real sobre un crimen por encargo en el excéntrico submundo de la cría de grandes felinos.

videos.title: Not Your Average Joe
videos.overview: Meet Joe Exotic, the gun-toting operator of an Oklahoma big cat park. He’s been accused of hiring someone to murder his chief rival, Carole Baskin.

videos.title: Cult of Personality
videos.overview: Subjected to long hours, little (or no) pay and the whims of eccentric bosses: are big cat park employees just cogs in a web of personality cults?

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: An incident in Carole's past casts her in a suspicious light, and while she maintains her innocence, Joe is all too happy to point the finger at her.

videos.title: Playing with Fire
videos.overview: Joe ramps up his efforts to become an internet and TV star, but a mysterious fire and lawsuit threaten his plans — until an angel investor appears.

videos.title: Make America Exotic Again
videos.overview: As Joe dives into politics, he deals with turmoil and tragedy in his personal life. Meanwhile, the dynamics at the park change with the new owners.

videos.title: The Noble Thing to Do
videos.overview: James Garretson makes a shocking claim about Joe, leading to FBI involvement. Desperation sets in for Joe, who thinks Jeff and James have set him up.

videos.title: Dethroned
videos.overview: Joe faces the music in the courtroom but insists the story is far from over. Jeff’s business prospects crumble. Former G.W. Zoo workers try to move on.

videos.title: The Tiger King and I
videos.overview: In this aftershow, Joel McHale talks with Jeff, Saff, Erik and more to get their reactions to the series, their portrayals  and their new fame

videos.title: Beg Your Pardon
videos.overview: With Joe in prison, others from the series seek to capitalize on their fame.  Meanwhile, a team forms to press Donald Trump for a presidential pardon.

videos.title: The Carole Diaries
videos.overview: Renewed interest in Don's disappearance leads authorities, journalists and his children to investigate how, when -- and even if -- he was killed.

videos.title: Bounty Hunting
videos.overview: Don's daughters escalate their efforts to learn more about their father's fate.  Carole's version of events faces further scrutiny.

videos.title: The Lyin' King
videos.overview: Jeff  goes on the defensive when acquaintances and former associates accuse him of misdeeds.  Meanwhile, Tim faces legal issues in Indiana.

videos.title: Stark Raving Mad
videos.overview: Tim vows to stand his ground.  Jeff goes to bat for Joe, but one last stunning claim from a familiar face turns the story on its head yet again.
